clue.text: Cloth cut the wrong way, poor stuff

indicators.note: turned the wrong way, so the word for cut is read from right to left

parts.note: to snip is to cut
tripe is slang for rubbish, poor stuff

explanation.surface: A complaint that a fabric was cut against the grain and is shoddy material.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the wrong way' turns SNIP into PINS; add TRIPE.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinstripe is a suiting fabric woven with fine stripes, so it names a kind of cloth.

clue.text: Like decoration that is the opposite of outstanding

definitions.text: Like decoration that is the opposite of outstanding

parts.words: Like decoration that is the opposite of outstanding
parts.note: ornament set flush into a surface rather than standing out from it, read literally as the reverse of 'out-standing'

explanation.surface: A description of ornament that is anything but remarkable.
explanation.definitionFit: Inlaid work is set into a surface, flush with it, rather than raised in relief.

clue.text: Bag a revolutionary brought into street

indicators.note: something brought into a word sits inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: Che Guevara is the crossword's stock revolutionary

explanation.surface: A rebel is carried into the road in a sack.
explanation.definitionFit: A sachet is a small sealed bag or packet.

clue.text: Distant spot engineers must go to

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
a mote is a speck or spot

explanation.surface: Army engineers are posted to a far-off place.
explanation.definitionFit: Remote is a synonym for far away.

clue.text: First female god given woman's name

parts.note: Pan is the Greek god of the wild
Dora is a woman's name

explanation.surface: The earliest woman is given a goddess-like name.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Pandora was the first mortal woman, made by the gods.

clue.text: One has decreasing numbers attending a launch

definitions.text: One has decreasing numbers attending a launch

parts.words: One has decreasing numbers attending a launch
parts.note: the numbers called out ten, nine, eight ... go down as a rocket lift-off approaches, not a crowd thinning at a product launch

explanation.surface: Fewer and fewer people turn up to a launch event.
explanation.definitionFit: A countdown is the backward count of seconds to zero before lift-off.

clue.text: After being perverted, you all end being pure

indicators.note: perverted means twisted out of shape, so the letters that follow are rearranged

explanation.surface: Corrupted, you all finally end up innocent.
explanation.definitionFit: Unalloyed literally means unmixed with another metal, hence pure or complete.

clue.text: Chinese piece of poetry seen in new translation

parts.note: a canto is a section of a long poem

indicators.note: put into a fresh translation, the letters of seen are rendered in a new order

explanation.surface: A section of verse appears in a fresh translation from the Chinese.
explanation.definitionFit: Cantonese is a Chinese language spoken in Guangdong and Hong Kong.

clue.text: Membrane that could be seen in one arc

indicators.note: the answer could be found within the letters of one arc once they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A thin layer might be spotted in a single curve.
explanation.definitionFit: The cornea is the transparent membrane at the front of the eye.

clue.text: Church has me entering factory for job assigned

indicators.note: pieces entering a word go inside it, here into the factory

parts.note: a plant is a factory
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A churchgoer gets work at a factory.
explanation.definitionFit: A placement is a position or work posting someone is given.

clue.text: Animal about to be eaten by smaller one that grips the leg

indicators.note: the first piece is swallowed by the second, so it sits inside it

parts.note: an ant is a much smaller animal

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the animal is read backwards

parts.note: an elk is a large deer

explanation.surface: A big beast is about to be devoured by a tiny creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns ELK into KLE, which 'to be eaten by' puts inside ANT.
explanation.definitionFit: An anklet is an ornament or band worn around the lower leg.

clue.text: Command about to be given in a manner of speaking

indicators.note: given in means inserted, so the word for about goes inside

parts.note: diction is one's manner of speaking
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: An order is about to be issued in a particular style of speech.
explanation.definitionFit: A direction is an instruction or order.

clue.text: Contact made with little woman drowned by a big noise

indicators.note: something drowned by another is submerged within it, so it goes inside

parts.note: din is a loud noise
Jo is one of the sisters in Little Women

explanation.surface: Contact is made with a small woman whose voice is drowned out by racket.
explanation.definitionFit: To adjoin is to touch or be next to, which is to be in contact.

clue.text: Society gets unfriendly — money no longer available

parts.note: chilling can mean cold and unfriendly

explanation.surface: A club turns cold when funds run out.
explanation.walkthrough: The schilling was Austria's currency, replaced by the euro.
explanation.definitionFit: The schilling was the Austrian unit of currency before the euro, so it is obsolete money.

clue.text: Mean, by implication, to give wrong identity?

definitions.text: Mean, by implication, to give wrong identity?

parts.words: Mean, by implication, to give wrong identity?
parts.note: the word mean is the word name with its letters rearranged, a falsified version of it; the clue also reads as intending an alias

explanation.surface: Someone intends to give a bogus identity.
explanation.definitionFit: A false name is an alias given to hide who one really is.

clue.text: Sell a herb, possibly, or some plants

indicators.note: possibly suggests the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A gardener might sell herbs or other plants.
explanation.definitionFit: Harebells are blue bell-shaped wild flowers.

clue.text: Undermine weak person

explanation.surface: Undermine weak person.
explanation.definitionFit: To sap is to weaken gradually; a sap is a fool or a feeble person.

clue.text: Not all those twits will be ready

indicators.note: only part of the words is used, so the answer lies within them

explanation.surface: Not every one of those idiots will be prepared.
explanation.definitionFit: Set means prepared, as in ready, steady, go.

clue.text: Work steadily at Devon port — but not at the entrance

indicators.note: but not excludes part of the word

parts.note: Plymouth is a port in Devon, south-west England
a mouth is an entrance, as of a cave or harbour

explanation.surface: Someone works hard at a harbour town, though not at its gateway.
explanation.definitionFit: To ply a trade is to work at it diligently.

clue.text: Absurd behaviour from artist in country by edge of lake

indicators.note: the artist sits in the country

parts.note: Chad is an African country
RA is a Royal Academician

indicators.note: the edge here is the closing letter

explanation.surface: Antics from a painter in an African land beside a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A charade is an absurd pretence or farce.

clue.text: Unblemished female heading off to become anarchic

indicators.note: the head of the word is taken off

parts.note: flawless means without blemish

explanation.surface: A spotless woman leaves to become a rebel.
explanation.definitionFit: Lawless means without order or rule, like anarchy.

clue.text: Go Conservative — nothing to lose!

indicators.note: losing something removes it from the word

parts.note: a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party
O is the round shape of zero, nothing

explanation.surface: An election slogan urging voters to switch to the Tories.
explanation.definitionFit: A go is an attempt, as is a try.

clue.text: Storm — something that slows down traffic along time

parts.note: a ramp is a raised hump in a road to slow cars
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: During a storm a speed hump holds up traffic for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: To storm about is to rampage, rushing around violently.

clue.text: Is taken to court — gets discharged

parts.note: to be sued is to be taken to court

explanation.surface: A man is sued and then released.
explanation.definitionFit: Issued means sent out or emitted, as discharged does.

clue.text: Go up to heather leering

indicators.note: in a down clue going up means read from the bottom

parts.note: ling is a common heather

explanation.surface: A walker heads up to the moorland heather.
explanation.definitionFit: Ogling and leering both mean staring lecherously.

clue.text: Use fan that's faulty and liable to give an electric shock?

definitions.text: liable to give an electric shock?

indicators.note: faulty means broken, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A warning against using a broken electric fan.
explanation.definitionFit: Unsafe means dangerous, and faulty wiring is dangerous because it can electrocute.

clue.text: One has inclination to be by river?

definitions.text: One has inclination to be by river?

parts.words: One has inclination to be by river?
parts.note: inclination reads as a liking, but angle also means to fish, so this is someone who fishes at a riverbank

explanation.surface: Someone likes to spend time beside a river.
explanation.definitionFit: An angler fishes with rod and line, often on a riverbank.

clue.text: Reckoning I am becoming senile sticking at home

parts.note: I'm is the contraction of I am

indicators.note: the home word is stuck into the senile word

parts.note: aging means growing old
in means at home

explanation.surface: I fear I'm going senile, staying indoors all day.
explanation.definitionFit: Imagining can mean supposing or thinking, as reckoning does.

clue.text: Berlin, Germany — see some hang about

indicators.note: only some of the letters are used, so the answer lies across the words

explanation.surface: Tourists in Berlin see people loitering.
explanation.definitionFit: To linger is to stay around, reluctant to leave.

clue.text: Graduate's in charge — supporter of the cause at heart

parts.note: BA is a Bachelor of Arts graduate, with the S of the possessive
an ally supports a cause

explanation.surface: A graduate leads, a devoted supporter of the movement.
explanation.definitionFit: Basically means fundamentally, at root.

clue.text: Agile doctor plunges into African river

indicators.note: plunging into something puts it inside

parts.note: the Nile is the great African river
MB is a Bachelor of Medicine

explanation.surface: A medic dives into the Nile.
explanation.definitionFit: Nimble means quick and light on one's feet.

clue.text: EU singers dancing around for foreign lords

indicators.note: dancing letters move about into a new order

explanation.surface: European singers dance around for overseas nobles.
explanation.definitionFit: Seigneurs are feudal lords, especially in France.
